hypothesis.decision_changed_if_negative: Any outcome closes this question with its measured noise and ensemble values; it releases no retry, more seeds, full training or adoption. A nomination is a question for the owner, not authority.
hypothesis.decision_changed_if_positive: Singles: x42 = 99.987 (retained) and x43..x46 from the new arms (50K dev MAE, meV, best-development-EMA selection as in the reference). D = max - min over the five; SD = sample standard deviation over the five. E5 = mean single MAE minus MAE of the 5-member equal mean prediction. Fit a + b/N over all subsets. - D < 1.0 meV: 500K init noise is small; past 500K single-seed verdicts of 1-2 meV stand as measured. - 1.0 <= D < 2.0 meV: 500K gates of 3 meV stay; 1-2 meV verdicts are unresolved. - D >= 2.0 meV: single-seed 500K screens are underpowered; future 500K screens need >= 2 inits per arm. - E5 >= 4.0 meV and a <= 95.5 meV: same-recipe ensembling is the leading 500K lever; nominate a deliverable-ensemble or out-of-fold distillation question to the owner (no adoption here). - E5 < 2.0 meV: the mixed 500K curve overstated ensembling; same-recipe ensembling has low value at 500K. - Cross-architecture readout: MAE of 5 GPTrans + best K1 500K (late-weight-average clean, 103.85) with equal and split-half-fitted weights, against the 5-member mean. A gain >= 1.0 meV keeps K1 + GPTrans mixing open at 500K; a gain < 0.5 meV closes it at 500K. - If only one kernel finishes: report its two singles as noise samples with x42; no D threshold. Falsifier: D < 1.0 meV and E5 < 2.0 meV together mean neither init noise nor variance limits 500K GPTrans, and the floor is data or representation. Row bootstrap is reported but is not training stochasticity.
hypothesis.observed_deficiency: Every 500K verdict is single-seed at 0.5-2.1 meV and no 500K noise floor exists; the 500K ensemble curve mixes size and LR variants.
